items.mainDefect: `max_processes or len(...)` treats an explicit 0 like None, so `--flusher-processes 0` gives one process per shard (the maximum) instead of a single process.

secondary.defect: A negative `--flusher-processes` value passes the `or`, makes `num_processes` negative and creates zero flusher processes, so nothing ever flushes Redis.

items.mainDefect: The `wait_produce` timer is tagged with the key `shards`, while the related flusher metrics use `shard`, so the shard dimension is split across two tag keys.

secondary.defect: `flusher_unhealthy` puts single per-shard ids under the `shard` tag, while main() uses a comma-joined `shard_tag`, so the same tag key has inconsistent value formats.

items.mainDefect: The newly added `_create_process_for_shard` method is never called anywhere.

secondary.defect: If `_create_process_for_shard` were ever called, it would restart shards without killing the old (possibly hung) process, leaking that process and its shared state.

items.mainDefect: The `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard in `_ensure_processes_alive` is never true for SpawnProcess instances, so hung processes are never killed before a replacement starts.

secondary.defect: The same wrong isinstance check gates `process.terminate()` in `join()`, so the shutdown terminate step never runs.

items.mainDefect: The internal child `ProcessSpansStrategyFactory(...)` instantiation does not forward `flusher_processes`, so on the multiprocess path the option is ignored and each child defaults to one flusher process per shard.

secondary.defect: Because `flusher_processes` was inserted right before `produce_to_pipe` in the signature, any call site that passes `produce_to_pipe` positionally now binds it to `flusher_processes`, causing a TypeError in `min()`.
